posts.title: I'm also an angry optimist
posts.description: This video was shared with me and I knew I was going to enjoy it. I have followed Jack Conte for quite a while mostly for his music and the musicians that have played with him. I knew he was the CEO of Patreon, but I did not realize how much he was into creating videos. Jack's Talk Direct Link to Jack's Video Emotional, Inspiring, and Incredible My form of artistic expression has always been music. I haven't written my own songs, but I have completed small compositions. I primarily played classical music and live musicals (trombone) before joining a few bands and playing bass guitar. Over the years I have picked up many more instruments, but trombone is still my favorite and bass is my default for new engagements. Jack's passion for the art he creates shines in this talk and reminds me that it is not only allowable to have multiple passions, but a real boon to life to have so many varied interests. posts.title: Hello, world!
posts.description: What is signal ? In a broad, cross-domain definition it represents any observable pattern that carries some information that is relevant . Data analysis : informative part of measurements (what changes that matters), distinct from noise. Computer science : a value/notification/event transmitted through some interface or channel (e.g., interrupts, signals, messages). Music : an acoustic pattern (pitch, rhythm, timbre, dynamics) conveying musical information to listeners. Internet consumption : verification that information shared is truthful and valid (cutting through social media and fake news claims). Daily life : cues you notice (smoke → fire, traffic → congestion, body language → mood) that inform decisions. What I want this blog to be A place for me to process the world around me and cut through the noise of modern life. This blog will bounce around a ton, but I will do my best to tag relevant observations for anyone interested in following along as I discover what it means to Sear
